case_name: Single drawdown, two equal annual repayments (basic APRC)
annex_basis: Directive 2008/48/EC Annex I Part I basic equation; no specific numbered example recalled
assumptions_applied: starting date = date of first drawdown t1=0
result rounded to at least one decimal, round-half-up
weakest_point: No specific Annex I numbered example with these exact figures is recalled; the case is constructed from the basic equation. Rounding convention is per Annex I remark (d) but the 'at least one decimal' allows 6.6%.

case_name: Single drawdown with arrangement fee paid at conclusion
annex_basis: Directive 2008/48/EC Annex I Part I; fee included as D at t=0 per flow concept (remark e)
assumptions_applied: fee paid at t=0 same as drawdown
flow sign convention: fee is a repayment/charge D
weakest_point: Charges paid at conclusion are captured via the flow-balance rewrite (remark e). Exact Annex I illustrative example for this pattern not recalled; constructed.

case_name: Irregular intervals — drawdown immediate, repayments at 3 months and 15 months
annex_basis: Directive 2008/48/EC Annex I Part I; month = 30.41666 days per remark (c)
assumptions_applied: month = 30.41666 days (365/12), regardless of leap year, per Annex I remark (c)
intervals converted to years as fractions
weakest_point: Month-to-year conversion uses 30.41666 days/month exactly as prescribed; the example numbers themselves are not recalled from a specific Annex I numbered example.

case_name: Freedom of drawdown — deemed immediate full drawdown, with quarterly repayments
annex_basis: Directive 2008/48/EC Annex I Part II assumption (a): freedom of drawdown => total credit drawn immediately and in full
assumptions_applied: total credit drawn immediately and in full (Part II assumption a)
fee included at t=0 as a charge
weakest_point: Assumption (a) of immediate full drawdown is directly from Annex I Part II; the numerical example is constructed. The exact conversion of quarter to 0.25 year relies on the 30.41666 days/month convention.

case_name: Overdraft facility — deemed drawn in full for whole duration (Annex I Part II assumption d) with illustrative 3-month horizon
annex_basis: Directive 2008/48/EC Annex I Part II assumption (d): overdraft total amount deemed drawn in full for whole duration
computation: 2030 = 2050/(1+X)^0.25 -> (1+X)^0.25 = 2050/2030 = 1.009852 -> 1+X = (1.009852)^4 = 1.0399 -> X = 0.0399 = 3.99% for the quarter. APRC annualised via the equation already solves for X as the annual rate; check: (1.0399)^(1/0.25)? No — the equation directly yields the effective annual rate X because we solved 2030 = 2050(1+X)^(-0.25) which implicitly assumes X is the annual rate and 0.25 is the fraction of year. Solve precisely: (1+X)^0.25 = 2050/2030 = 1.0098522167 -> 1+X = 1.0098522167^4. Compute: ln(1.0098522167)=0.009805, *4 = 0.03922, exp = 1.03996. So X = 0.03996 = 3.996%. Rounded to one decimal: 4.0%.
assumptions_applied: overdraft drawn in full for entire duration (Part II d)
weakest_point: Assumption (d) for overdrafts is explicitly in Annex I Part II, but the quantitative example (3-month horizon, 10% nominal) is illustrative and not recalled as a specific numbered Annex example. The 3-month horizon is a common simplification; the actual Annex may use a different standard horizon.
